name: Gloria Romero
title: Republican nominee for Lieutenant Governor of California (2026); former state Senate Majority Leader
years_of_service: State Assembly (49th District) December 1998 to March 2001; State Senate (24th District) March 2001 to November 2010; Senate Majority Leader 2005 to 2008. (Wikipedia)
background: Romero was born July 10, 1955, in Barstow. She holds an associate degree from Barstow Community College, a B.A. and M.A. from Cal State Long Beach, and a Ph.D. in psychology from UC Riverside, and taught as a university professor before entering politics. (Wikipedia)

As a Democrat she served nearly 12 years in the Legislature and was the first woman to serve as Senate Majority Leader (2005 to 2008). As Senate Education Committee chair she authored California's "parent trigger" law, which lets parents at a persistently failing school petition to restructure it. She ran for Superintendent of Public Instruction in 2010 with charter-school backing and finished third with 17.0%. (Wikipedia)

She left the Democratic Party on September 4, 2024, registered Republican, and endorsed Donald Trump. In January 2026 she joined Steve Hilton's ticket and placed second in the June 2 lieutenant governor primary with 17.83%. (Wikipedia; CalMatters)
